summary: Comprehensive e2e testing of BrewSpot. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass covering auth, cafes, reviews (CRUD + recompute), favorites, admin CRUD, barista SSE streaming, and AI summary. Frontend: home hero search, explore filters, cafe detail (tabs, AI summary, write/edit review), favorites page, admin dashboard with add-cafe modal, surprise-me nav, and AI Barista streaming with recommendation mini-cards all working on desktop and mobile 390px.

minor.issue: backend/.env sets CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True in server.py. Browsers reject wildcard origin with credentials; cookie-based auth from browser would fail. App uses Bearer-token flow so UI still works, but refresh via httpOnly cookie across origins is effectively unusable from a strict-CORS browser context.

issues: Uses native <select> for Price level and Noise level and native text inputs for Opens/Closes (HH:MM) instead of shadcn Select/TimePicker — inconsistent with rest of the app's shadcn styling.
Radix a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for better a11y.
Document title is 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of a BrewSpot-branded title.

action_items: Replace CORS_ORIGINS="*" in /app/backend/.env with the explicit public frontend origin (https://roast-rate-1.preview.emergentagent.com) to make httpOnly cookie refresh usable from the browser.
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to all shadcn DialogContent usages (write-review dialog, admin cafe dialog) to clear a11y console warnings.
Consider swapping native <select>/time inputs in Admin cafe form to shadcn Select / consistent inputs for design parity.
Update <title> in /app/frontend/public/index.html to a BrewSpot-branded title.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 502: allow_credentials=True with allow_origins=['*'] is a CORS misconfiguration — must use explicit origin list when credentials are allowed.
Review helpful endpoint allows self-upvote (no guard against user_id == rev.user_id). Minor product gap.
AI summary cache keyed only on review_count — summary won't refresh when reviews are edited without count change. Low-impact edge case.
server.py is 503 lines (within limit) but handles too many domains; consider splitting into auth.py, cafes.py, reviews.py, admin.py, ai.py routers for maintainability.
login_attempts collection is not pruned; use TTL index on locked_until to avoid growth.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; only cosmetic/a11y issues)

test_credentials: admin@brewspot.app / admin123 ; demo@brewspot.app / demo123 (as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_* cafes (admin CRUD test deletes its own); demo user accumulates two 'TEST ...' reviews visible on /favorites — safe to leave or clean up later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_brewspot_api.py (uses pytest-xdist, 2 workers). All 25 pass. Barista streams SSE at POST /api/barista/chat (events are 'data: {"delta": ...}' then 'data: {"done": true}'). AI summary endpoint can be slow (~5-15s) due to Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5. Admin / Demo creds seeded on startup via server.seed(). CORS wildcard+credentials is the main backend config smell.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs blocking the MVP. CORS misconfiguration is a configuration bug: CORSMiddleware silently refuses to echo Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* when allow_credentials=True (Starlette downgrades to no credentials); fix by setting CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit public URL in backend/.env.
